Which observatory stations (`observstation`) have an average telescope bandwidth usage (`bandusagepct`) above the overall average bandwidth usage? Ignore missing values. For each one, show the station, its average bandwidth usage, and how much it exceeds the overall average. Return the top 10 by that margin, largest first, without rounding. Weight by signals: join telescopes to signals, and average each station's and the overall usage per signal rather than per telescope.
queries:
SELECT observstation,
       AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct,
       AVG(bandusagepct) - (SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL) AS margin
FROM telescopes
WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY observstation
HAVING AVG(bandusagepct) > (SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL)
ORDER BY margin DESC
LIMIT 10;
WITH station_avg AS (
  SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_usage
  FROM telescopes
  WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY observstation
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_usage) AS overall_avg FROM station_avg
)
SELECT s.observstation,
       s.avg_usage,
       s.avg_usage - o.overall_avg AS margin
FROM station_avg s, overall o
WHERE s.avg_usage > o.overall_avg
ORDER BY margin DESC
LIMIT 10;
WITH per_signal AS (
  SELECT t.observstation AS observstation, t.bandusagepct AS bandusagepct
  FROM telescopes t
  JOIN signals s ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry
  WHERE t.bandusagepct IS NOT NULL
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) AS overall_avg FROM per_signal
)
SELECT p.observstation,
       AVG(p.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct,
       AVG(p.bandusagepct) - o.overall_avg AS margin_over_overall
FROM per_signal p
CROSS JOIN overall o
GROUP BY p.observstation, o.overall_avg
HAVING AVG(p.bandusagepct) > o.overall_avg
ORDER BY margin_over_overall DESC
LIMIT 10;
